probe: P2 COI-driven budget + scalar-closure sufficiency (read-only, no training)

method.mechanical_equation: M*omega_dot = -grad U - D*omega + q_p*p - r; 1^T grad U = 0
method.r1_definition: R1 = 1^T r / 10; W1 = 1^T omega / 10 (unweighted collective mean)
method.coi_definition: dw_COI = sum_i M_i*(omega_pred_i-omega_true_i) / sum_i M_i (model-M weighted)
method.budget_integral: cumulative trapezoid, dt=0.01, from the first compared sample
method.budget_closure: max|dw_COI - (I_r+I_D+I_p)/sum M|; also after removing dw_COI(0)
method.scalar_closure: dR1/dt = kappa W1 - lambda R1; exact identity of 1^T Q = lambda 1^T
method.scalar_integration: piecewise-linear-exact: W1 linear between 0.01 s samples; no RK4 truncation
method.scalar_fit: fixed lambda grid geomspace(1e-3,10,241); (R10,kappa) linear least squares per lambda
method.scalar_fit_short_window: fit skipped below 20 samples (3 free parameters would be degenerate); short windows remain an optimistic in-sample lower bound and nonpositive fitted kappa is counted, not clipped
method.cross_check: same inversion/integration on the model's own (omega,p,r) path

mechanical_identity.substitution: none; each model uses its own frozen buffers

headline_gap.definition: paired per-event differences (left - right) on the same windows

limitations: Frozen fit297 train evidence only; already consumed, not independent confirmation.
R1_est is a mechanical-inversion estimate under the frozen M/D/q_p, not the true hidden force.
The COI budget is closed by construction up to the initial COI offset and finite-difference/trapezoid error.
The three terminal-value shares can be ill-conditioned because the terms cancel; mean-absolute shares are reported alongside.

A per-event best (kappa,lambda,R10) fit is an optimistic in-sample bound on a single global closure; short unstable windows are excluded below 20 samples and nonpositive fitted kappa is counted, not clipped.
Unstable-prefix windows are short (min 3, median 26 samples), so prefix fit/amplification ratios are numerically fragile and are not evidence about closure form.
No training, no optimizer call, no rollout, no val/test, no model promotion, no mechanism identification.
